crossRefs.note: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,
(for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore…
As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.
Yahweh has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

people.name: Melchizedek
people.line: King of Salem and priest of God Most High.

translations.web: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”
translations.bsb: For it is testified: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
translations.kjv: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
translations.asv: for it is witnessed of him, Thou art a priest for ever After the order of Melchizedek.
